bootstrap.invalid_draw_policy: omit draws lacking either outcome class and report valid draw count

disclosure.development_status: The benchmark was examined while ISDS was conceptualized. The fixed formula was selected for interpretability, batch invariance, and deployability and frozen before the locked final run.
disclosure.validation_status: Internal, system-aware benchmark evaluation; not external validation.

formula.cutoff_statement: no binary ISDS cutoff is selected or validated in this study
formula.direction_policy: absolute magnitude enters ISDS; signed energies remain in the mechanism profile
formula.missing_policy: ISDS is NA unless at least one energy axis and a valid structural-context tier are available
formula.probability_statement: ISDS is a unitless prioritization index, not a probability
formula.threshold_policy: the binary mechanism-call threshold is not applied inside ISDS

populations.structural_prioritization: 47 interaction variants with a tier and a structural-mechanism-versus-no-modeled-lesion label

primary_endpoint.negative: no committed lesion on the modeled COMAVI axes

purpose.localization: Preserve the separate monomer-fold, complex-context, and binding-interface mechanism profile.
purpose.prioritization: Rank variants by combined energetic and structural-context evidence for a modeled structural disruption.
